I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. I confirmed that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 21 December.

- **Nothing else to do:** he said no action was needed. His message is in a team channel, so the workspace brain saves it automatically and I didn't write a separate note.
- **No conflicting date found:** I searched the brain for an earlier Thornbury deadline and found none. That search ran in keyword-only mode, so it may have missed records worded differently.
- **Nothing outside the channel:** a deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure. I sent no mail and didn't need any approvals.
